faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHO Ri Bhoi ANM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DMHO Ri Bhoi ANM Recruitment 2026 is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ANM post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the ANM post announced by the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi (DMHO Ri Bhoi) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the ANM post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for the ANM post is ANM from an Institution recognized by the Nursing Council of India and registration under the Meghalaya Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DMHO Ri Bhoi ANM Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the ANM post?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ANM post in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ANM recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ANM recruitment involves a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the ANM position?
faq.answer: The ANM positions are offered on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi, which is https://ribhoi.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the important dates for the recruitment process?
faq.answer: Key dates include the Notification Date on 21st September 2026, the Last Date for Application on 10th September 2026, the Written Test on 15th September 2026, and the Interview on 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DMHO/RBD/NHM/HR-UHWC/253/2626-27.
